current.text: Phoenix acquired Bridges in a trade that sent Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neale out.
He is the projected starting power forward, next to Jalen Green, Devin Booker, Dillon Brooks and Oso Ighodaro.
The Suns hope his ball handling, rim pressure and catch-and-shoot threes take pressure off Booker.
He shares the ball with Booker, Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks and Collin Gillespie. His usage was only 20% in preseason.
Experts expect his usage to drop in Phoenix, and they expect his value to drop with it.
He sprained his ankle in preseason. He seems okay, but Yahoo lists him as questionable.
Experts call him a bust at a rank around 80 to 100. ESPN's rank near 77 to 80 and an ADP near 99 are 20 to 30 spots too high.
Around pick 120 to 140 he is fair to good value. He slides to rounds 11 to 12 in mock drafts. One expert calls a rank of about 120 right, and another says 120 is too late for him.
Phoenix has the best fantasy schedule in the league: 4 games in each of weeks 19, 20 and 21, plus the fewest back-to-backs.

durable.text: He only puts up strong numbers when he is the number one option with high usage. His best production came when LaMelo Ball and Brandon Miller were injured. His minutes shrank when he was asked to scale back.
His athleticism has declined a lot in recent years. He no longer gets many steals or blocks, and his finishing at the rim has dropped.
He shot 33% from three last season. Experts say his three-point shot was never reliable outside one outlier season.
Experts rate him as a poor passer and at best an inconsistent defender.
His category profile is broad with no weak outlier. Points, rebounds, threes and FT% are modest pluses, and FG% and steals are modest minuses.

note: Our league paid 11 USD for him last season. This year Yahoo values him at 5 USD (average cost 1.7) and ESPN at 4 USD (rank 78), and experts see fair value only around pick 120 to 140. That puts him in the last rounds of our 144-player pool, so treat him as a 1 to 4 USD end-of-draft forward with no weak category and a 4-4-4 playoff schedule, and do not pay for an ESPN rank near 78. Early in the season, check his ankle and whether his usage holds up next to Booker, Jalen Green and Brooks, because his value needs a big shot share.
